node.title: PROVED (X-6): the characteristic-zero lifting theorem
node.statement: If char(F_q) = p > max_{r <= t} C(b,r)^phi(n), then every b-subset of mu_n (2-power n) with e_1 = ... = e_t = 0 is a union of mu_M-cosets, M = 2^ceil(log2(t+1)) > t — quotient-staircase charged; if M does not divide b, no such block exists. UNIFORM IN b. Proof: mod-p vanishing lifts to characteristic zero above the norm bound; char-0 e_1 = 0 with 0/1 indicator forces Phi_n | P_B hence antipodal closure B = -B; locator descends to Q_1(X^2); iterate. Verified here. The threshold (~phi(n) log2 C(b,r) bits — thousands) is far above 2^128: correct but not the requested bound.
node.notes: PROVENANCE: GPT Pro X-6. The elegant core: antipodal descent — each moment level halves the domain; the 2-power structure does the rest.
